reason: stellar-core's transaction-set builder always writes a base fee into a non-empty component (sequentialPhaseToXdr and parallelPhaseToXdr in src/herder/TxSetFrame.cpp take every lane's base fee from the surge-pricing computation, an int64), while its validation accepts a component without one and then charges each transaction its own bid (TxSetFrame.cpp, the inclusion-fee map built from an absent baseFee). So only a validator running a modified builder can put this into a consensus ledger; a standalone node cannot. The base ledger's transactions each bid exactly the base fee, so the fees core charged equal what a ledger without the base fee charges. The edit recomputes scpValue.txSetHash and the header hash; the scpValue signature still signs the old set hash, which no reader checks
